newsitem.title: UK: Italy minister warns against more sharp CPI falls.
newsitem.headline: Italy minister warns against more sharp CPI falls.

text.p: Italian inflation may dip slightly this month but further strong falls would be a sign the economy was suffering, Italian Trade Minister Augusto Fantozzi told reporters during a visit to London on Monday.
Italian inflation fell to 1.7 percent year-on-year in April from 2.2 percent in March.

"(Inflation) might fall a little bit more in May but I believe that by now we are close to unrestrainable levels," Fantozzi said. "A further, more significant fall would then be a sign that the Italian economy was suffering."
Preliminary May inflation data is due later this month.
Italian ministers recently indicated that inflation might touch 1.5 percent year-on-year in May but expected a slight technical bounce in future months. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
